import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras
from tensorflow.keras import layers
import warnings
import gc

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)
tf.random.set_seed(42)

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Extract target
y = train["target"].values
train_ids = train["id"].values
test_ids = test["id"].values

# Remove id and target from feature sets
train_features = train.drop(columns=["id", "target"])
test_features = test.drop(columns=["id"])


# Enhanced feature engineering for string feature f_27
def extract_f27_features(df):
    f27 = df["f_27"].astype(str)

    # Original character count features
    char_counts = pd.DataFrame()
    for i, char in enumerate("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"):
        char_counts[f"f27_{char}_count"] = f27.str.count(char)

    # Position features
    char_positions = pd.DataFrame()
    for i, char in enumerate("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"):
        char_positions[f"f27_{char}_first_pos"] = f27.str.find(char)
        char_positions[f"f27_{char}_last_pos"] = f27.str.rfind(char)

    # Length, unique chars, duplicate chars
    f27_len = f27.str.len()
    char_counts["f27_length"] = f27_len
    char_counts["f27_unique_chars"] = f27.apply(lambda x: len(set(x)))
    char_counts["f27_duplicate_chars"] = f27_len - char_counts["f27_unique_chars"]

    # Character frequency ratios
    for char in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ":
        char_counts[f"f27_{char}_freq"] = char_counts[f"f27_{char}_count"] / f27_len

    # Sum and product of character counts
    char_cols = [c for c in char_counts.columns if "_count" in c]
    char_counts["f27_sum_counts"] = char_counts[char_cols].sum(axis=1)
    char_counts["f27_max_count"] = char_counts[char_cols].max(axis=1)
    char_counts["f27_min_count"] = char_counts[char_cols].min(axis=1)

    # Sequential pattern features
    # Count of repeating bigrams (AA, BB, ..., ZZ)
    bigram_counts = pd.DataFrame()
    for char in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ":
        pattern = char + char
        bigram_counts[f"f27_{char}{char}_count"] = f27.str.count(pattern)

    bigram_counts["f27_repeated_bigrams"] = bigram_counts.sum(axis=1)

    # Count of unique consecutive pairs
    def count_unique_pairs(s):
        pairs = set()
        for i in range(len(s) - 1):
            pairs.add(s[i] + s[i + 1])
        return len(pairs)

    char_counts["f27_unique_pairs"] = f27.apply(count_unique_pairs)

    # Count of descending sequences
    def count_descending_sequences(s):
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(s) - 2):
            if ord(s[i]) > ord(s[i + 1]) > ord(s[i + 2]):
                count += 1
        return count

    char_counts["f27_descending_triplets"] = f27.apply(count_descending_sequences)

    # Count of ascending sequences
    def count_ascending_sequences(s):
        count = 0
        for i in range(len(s) - 2):
            if ord(s[i]) < ord(s[i + 1]) < ord(s[i + 2]):
                count += 1
        return count

    char_counts["f27_ascending_triplets"] = f27.apply(count_ascending_sequences)

    # First and last character
    char_counts["f27_first_char"] = f27.str[0].apply(ord) - ord("A")
    char_counts["f27_last_char"] = f27.str[-1].apply(ord) - ord("A")

    # Character diversity metrics
    char_counts["f27_evenness"] = char_counts["f27_max_count"] / (
        char_counts["f27_sum_counts"] + 1e-6
    )
    char_counts["f27_gini_like"] = 1.0 - sum(
        char_counts[f"f27_{char}_freq"] ** 2 for char in "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    )

    return pd.concat([char_counts, char_positions, bigram_counts], axis=1)


# Extract f_27 features
train_f27 = extract_f27_features(train_features)
test_f27 = extract_f27_features(test_features)

# Remove f_27 string column and keep numeric features
numeric_cols = [col for col in train_features.columns if col != "f_27"]
train_numeric = train_features[numeric_cols].copy()
test_numeric = test_features[numeric_cols].copy()

# Add integer feature statistics
integer_cols = train_numeric.select_dtypes(include=["int64"]).columns
for df in [train_numeric, test_numeric]:
    df["int_sum"] = df[integer_cols].sum(axis=1)
    df["int_mean"] = df[integer_cols].mean(axis=1)
    df["int_max"] = df[integer_cols].max(axis=1)
    df["int_min"] = df[integer_cols].min(axis=1)
    df["int_std"] = df[integer_cols].std(axis=1).fillna(0)
    df["int_range"] = df["int_max"] - df["int_min"]

# Select top 10 float columns for polynomial and PCA features
float_cols = train_numeric.select_dtypes(include=["float64"]).columns
float_cols_subset = float_cols[:10]

# Create interaction features
train_interactions = pd.DataFrame()
test_interactions = pd.DataFrame()

for i in range(len(float_cols_subset)):
    for j in range(i + 1, len(float_cols_subset)):
        col1, col2 = float_cols_subset[i], float_cols_subset[j]
        train_interactions[f"{col1}_x_{col2}"] = (
            train_numeric[col1] * train_numeric[col2]
        )
        test_interactions[f"{col1}_x_{col2}"] = test_numeric[col1] * test_numeric[col2]

# Add squared polynomial features
poly_cols = float_cols_subset[:5]
for col in poly_cols:
    train_interactions[f"{col}_squared"] = train_numeric[col] ** 2
    test_interactions[f"{col}_squared"] = test_numeric[col] ** 2

# Add PCA components
pca = PCA(n_components=3, random_state=42)
pca_train = pca.fit_transform(train_numeric[float_cols_subset])
pca_test = pca.transform(test_numeric[float_cols_subset])

train_pca = pd.DataFrame(pca_train, columns=[f"pca_{i}" for i in range(3)])
test_pca = pd.DataFrame(pca_test, columns=[f"pca_{i}" for i in range(3)])

# Combine all features
X = pd.concat([train_numeric, train_f27, train_interactions, train_pca], axis=1)
X_test = pd.concat([test_numeric, test_f27, test_interactions, test_pca], axis=1)

# Scale features
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)

X_scaled = pd.DataFrame(X_scaled, columns=X.columns)
X_test_scaled = pd.DataFrame(X_test_scaled, columns=X.columns)

# Free memory
gc.collect()

# Split for validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_scaled, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)


# Build neural network model
def create_model(input_dim):
    model = keras.Sequential(
        [
            layers.Input(shape=(input_dim,)),
            layers.BatchNormalization(),
            layers.Dropout(0.2),
            layers.Dense(256, activation="elu", kernel_initializer="he_normal"),
            layers.BatchNormalization(),
            layers.Dropout(0.3),
            layers.Dense(128, activation="elu", kernel_initializer="he_normal"),
            layers.BatchNormalization(),
            layers.Dropout(0.3),
            layers.Dense(64, activation="elu", kernel_initializer="he_normal"),
            layers.BatchNormalization(),
            layers.Dropout(0.2),
            layers.Dense(1, activation="sigmoid"),
        ]
    )

    model.compile(
        optimizer=keras.optimizers.Adam(learning_rate=0.001),
        loss="binary_crossentropy",
        metrics=["accuracy"],
    )
    return model


# Create model
model = create_model(X_train.shape[1])

# Callbacks
early_stopping = keras.callbacks.EarlyStopping(
    monitor="val_auc", mode="max", patience=15, restore_best_weights=True, verbose=0
)

reduce_lr = keras.callbacks.ReduceLROnPlateau(
    monitor="val_auc", mode="max", factor=0.5, patience=5, min_lr=1e-6, verbose=0
)


# Custom AUC callback for validation
class AUCCallback(keras.callbacks.Callback):
    def __init__(self, X_val, y_val):
        self.X_val = X_val
        self.y_val = y_val
        self.best_auc = 0
        self.best_weights = None

    def on_epoch_end(self, epoch, logs=None):
        val_pred = self.model.predict(self.X_val, verbose=0).flatten()
        val_auc = roc_auc_score(self.y_val, val_pred)
        if val_auc > self.best_auc:
            self.best_auc = val_auc
            self.best_weights = self.model.get_weights()

    def on_train_end(self, logs=None):
        if self.best_weights is not None:
            self.model.set_weights(self.best_weights)


auc_callback = AUCCallback(X_val.values, y_val)

# Train model
history = model.fit(
    X_train.values,
    y_train,
    validation_data=(X_val.values, y_val),
    epochs=100,
    batch_size=1024,
    callbacks=[early_stopping, reduce_lr, auc_callback],
    verbose=0,
)

# Validation prediction and AUC
val_pred = model.predict(X_val.values, verbose=0).flatten()
auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC: {auc:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
test_pred = model.predict(X_test_scaled.values, verbose=0).flatten()

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
